  • 枚举常量详细资料

    • CHEST

      public static final InventoryType CHEST
      A chest inventory, with 0, 9, 18, 27, 36, 45, or 54 slots of type CONTAINER. 箱子物品栏，具有 0、9、18、27、36、45 或 54 个 CONTAINER 类型的槽位。

    • DISPENSER

      public static final InventoryType DISPENSER
      A dispenser inventory, with 9 slots of type CONTAINER. 发射器物品栏，具有 9 个 CONTAINER 类型的槽位。

    • DROPPER

      public static final InventoryType DROPPER
      A dropper inventory, with 9 slots of type CONTAINER. 投掷器物品栏，具有 9 个 CONTAINER 类型的槽位。

    • FURNACE

      public static final InventoryType FURNACE
      A furnace inventory, with a RESULT slot, a CRAFTING slot, and a FUEL slot. 熔炉物品栏，具有一个 RESULT 槽位、一个 CRAFTING 槽位和一个 FUEL 槽位。

    • WORKBENCH

      public static final InventoryType WORKBENCH
      A workbench inventory, with 9 CRAFTING slots and a RESULT slot. 工作台物品栏，具有 9 个 CRAFTING 槽位和 1 个 RESULT 槽位。

    • CRAFTING

      public static final InventoryType CRAFTING
      A player's crafting inventory, with 4 CRAFTING slots and a RESULT slot. Also implies that the 4 ARMOR slots are accessible. 玩家的合成物品栏，具有 4 个 CRAFTING 槽位和 1 个 RESULT 槽位。同时意味着 4 个 ARMOR 槽位也是可访问的。

    • ENCHANTING

      public static final InventoryType ENCHANTING
      An enchantment table inventory, with two CRAFTING slots and three enchanting buttons. 附魔台物品栏，具有两个 CRAFTING 槽位和三个附魔按钮。

    • BREWING

      public static final InventoryType BREWING
      A brewing stand inventory, with one FUEL slot and three CRAFTING slots. 酿造台物品栏，具有一个 FUEL 槽位和三个 CRAFTING 槽位。

    • PLAYER

      public static final InventoryType PLAYER
      A player's inventory, with 9 QUICKBAR slots, 27 CONTAINER slots, and 4 ARMOR slots. The ARMOUR slots may not be visible to the player, though. 玩家物品栏，具有 9 个 QUICKBAR 槽位、27 个 CONTAINER 槽位和 4 个 ARMOR 槽位。不过 ARMOR 槽位可能对玩家不可见。

    • CREATIVE

      public static final InventoryType CREATIVE
      The creative mode inventory, with only 9 QUICKBAR slots and nothing else. (The actual creative interface with the items is client-side and cannot be altered by the server.) 创造模式物品栏，只有 9 个 QUICKBAR 槽位，没有其他内容。（真正包含物品的创造界面位于客户端，服务器无法修改。）

    • MERCHANT

      public static final InventoryType MERCHANT
      The merchant inventory, with 2 TRADE-IN slots, and 1 RESULT slot. 村民交易物品栏，具有 2 个 TRADE-IN 槽位和 1 个 RESULT 槽位。

    • ENDER_CHEST

      public static final InventoryType ENDER_CHEST
      The ender chest inventory, with 27 slots. 末影箱物品栏，具有 27 个槽位。

    • ANVIL

      public static final InventoryType ANVIL
      An anvil inventory, with 2 CRAFTING slots and 1 RESULT slot 铁砧物品栏，具有 2 个 CRAFTING 槽位和 1 个 RESULT 槽位

    • BEACON

      public static final InventoryType BEACON
      A beacon inventory, with 1 CRAFTING slot 信标物品栏，具有 1 个 CRAFTING 槽位

    • HOPPER

      public static final InventoryType HOPPER
      A hopper inventory, with 5 slots of type CONTAINER. 漏斗物品栏，具有 5 个 CONTAINER 类型的槽位。
